title: NMR Analyzer: a noise-adaptive, dependency-free desktop application for reproducible 1D and 2D NMR analysis
description: A standard-library-only desktop application for reproducible inspection and quantification of one- and two-dimensional NMR spectra. It reads Bruker, ACD/Labs ESP, and JCAMP-DX data and provides processing, peak picking, integration, line-shape fitting, contour display, and a researcher-supervised structure-consistency check.
